title: Cloudify physical package state (schema_version 1, lean record)
description: The last confirmed observation of one package instance for one deployment on one host. The inventory path carries the application, flavor, deployment, package, package-instance, and host identities, so the record duplicates none of them. Applied settings are root scalars; classified secret names hold exactly '****' and never a value, digest, provider location, or redacted flag. A failed operation preserves confirmed settings and sets failed: true; a successful install or reconfigure replaces settings and clears it; a passing verify changes neither.

target.description: Runbook slot that owns this record; an _direct record uses 'direct'.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing subject revision; conceptual revision 0 is the absence of the record. It changes only under the host mutation lock and only together with an event.

version.description: Installed package version reported by the recipe, or null when the recipe reports none or a migration proves none.

failed.description: Present only when the last operation failed; a failed operation preserves confirmed settings. Cleared by a successful install or reconfigure, never by a passing verify.

user_forced.description: Names supplied by the environment when last successfully applied; a name here re-supplies from the environment and outranks defaults at reconfigure until 'deployment unset' releases it.

component.description: One validated identity path component; rules in schemas/v1/identity.md.

value_name.description: One declared value name; the uppercase namespace that separates settings from lowercase metadata keys.
